This great soup combines all of the tastes of a Reuben Sandwich. Serve it with a glass of Cold Beer

In a large soup pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and saute until tender, about 5 minutes.

Sprinkle flour over onions and mix well. Add Stock and stir in Sauerkraut.

Add remaining ingredients except bread and swiss cheese, simmer 18 (15-20) minutes Remove bay leaf and trash it.

Pre-heat broiler. when soup is ready to be served, Place bread on baking sheet and broil for about 2 minutes. Turn and sprinkle with swiss cheese, broil until melted, about one minute. ( dont go anywhere this toast turns into burnt bread fast.)

Ladle Soup into Bowls, and float one piece of toast on top of each bowl. Pass remaining toast as an accompaniment.

Serves 4

Ingredient List

  • 2 Tablespoons Butter
  • 1/2 cup chopped yellow onion
  • 1 Table spoon all pourpose flour
  • 4 cups beef stock
  • 1 cup sauerkraut drained and rinsed
  • 1 bay leaf
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
  • Fresh ground black pepper (to Taste)
  • 1/2 Pound thin sliced deli corned beef, shredded
  • 10 - 12 slices cocktail rye bread
  • 2 cups grated swiss cheese

The chilli was not 'as good' but was still fully edible.
